Class TrafficLight.Signal

java.lang.Object
TrafficLight.Signal
Enclosing class:
TrafficLight
public static class TrafficLight.Signal extends Object
Represents an individual signal controlling one lane-to-lane connection. Each signal has its own position, direction, and link index in the traffic light state.
